current.analysis: Learn selector and exact stable REST contract identify 2025-11-01. Schemas helper expanded Registry through common-types v6 TrackedResource: required location and sku; Sku.name required. It validated Premium, network/encryption/trust/quarantine/retention enums, boolean fields, retention days integer, and string-valued tags. The existing declaration is reference-only.

ga.analysis: Latest GA from the Learn version selector is 2025-11-01; newer listed APIs are previews. Current and candidate schema use the exact same pinned stable file.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log for 2025-11-01 removes softDeletePolicy, autoGeneratedDomainNameLabelScope, and metadataSearch from Registry models; none is used in this source. The specified sku, tags, network, encryption and policies fields remain valid in the exact current schema.
